method: Clapeyron residual r = (dPs/dT) T Dv / L - 1

routes.A: ideal vapour Dv = R_v T / Ps
routes.B: Z_v corrected Dv = Z_v R_v T / Ps

summary.verdict: holds (largely an identity; the independent-curve residuals also pass)
summary.identity_caveat: dP/dT, L and Z_v come from the same IF97 equations, and Dv_B = 1/rho_v exactly, so the Z_v-corrected IF97 residual is near zero by construction. The independent-curve residuals (Antoine and IAPWS-95 derivatives) carry the test.
